subpages.title: HT Networks | About Us
subpages.text: Hi-Tech Networks Technology Ltd. (Short is HT-Net) is one of the leading manufacturers of Layer3, Layer2, 40G, 10G Gigabit Ethernet Switches, PoE Switches, Enterprise Routers, Network Security Products, Fiber connectivity products specifically designed for harsh and demanding environments beside this we are also manufacturing Wireless Products includes Access Points and Wireless Controller. Founded in 2011, Head Quarter lies in Brisbane Australia and Regional Head office and Factory lies in Shenzhen China, HT-Net specializes in the design and manufacture of Industrial Ethernet switches, media converters, SFP transceiver and power over Ethernet products for applications where connectivity is crucial. With our core focus on Ethernet connectivity we do not compromise on quality and invest 15% of company annual sales amount in R&D every year. We have lots of satisfied customers all over the world who have been using our products and satisfied with our quality and support, We strongly believe that business success comes from customer success, and we always been committed to become the most outstanding provider of new generation data center and cloud computing solution in the network communication industry across the globe. HT-Net Head Quarter, Brisbane Australia Our Mission Our mission is to provide total IT solutions to our customers with top quality products and help our partners to provide best quality solutions to customers all over the world. Our Vision To be recognized as the most trusted name in the field of Information Technology solutions & services and provide world class quality products of high value, enabling distributors, partners & clients to maximize their business. subpages.text: Worldwide Offices Hi-Tech Networks Technology Ltd global presence spans across North America, Asia, and Europe. The company has branch offices in Canada, the United Kingdom, and China. HT-Net currently serves over 70 countries via our worldwide distribution channels. Thanks to our international distribution centers and offices, we are able to offer timely logistic services and support to customers around the globe. HT-Net prioritizes its customers and makes a concerted effort to fulfill all their local and global networking needs.
